# The scoped tier's selector's probes (TestGateSelectReach), one per line:
#
#   <changed path> | <packages whose tests it reaches, or -> [| <output line>...]
#
# The data rule reads test files' path literals as the data they read, so a
# probe named in a test file would reach that test's package by naming it.
# The probes live here, where the selector does not look.

# A Go file in no package: the module's tree walkers (TestLicenceHeaders,
# TestNoHostFacts) read every Go file, whatever go list sees.
tools/release.go | internal/guarantees
spec/conformance/gen.go | internal/guarantees
_tools/x.go | internal/guarantees

# The probes Wave 6's verification showed reached.
internal/dates/dates.go | internal/dates internal/cli internal/guarantees internal/conformance cmd/metais | code internal/dates/dates.go
cmd/metais/main.go | cmd/metais internal/guarantees internal/conformance | code cmd/metais/main.go
internal/zipfmt/testdata/x.zip | internal/zipfmt
internal/finding/testdata/unwired.txt | internal/finding
internal/specdata/schemas/x.json | internal/specdata
spec/13-authoring.md | internal/guarantees internal/conformance internal/specdata internal/loader
examples/x/example.yaml | internal/guarantees
.claude/skills/verification-gate/gate-select.sh | internal/guarantees | seam .claude/skills/verification-gate/gate-select.sh

# The control, last: data no test names reaches nothing, so the reach above
# is the rules', not a selector that tests everything.
